text.description_html:
Global DH-TAN5005, Bommer Replacement 5" Double Acting Spring Hinge

5" Double Acting Spring Hinge. Mortise Type - Door flange is mortised into edge of door. Jamb flange is surface applied to door jamb. For doors 1-1/8" to 1-1/2" thick.

Global 5" Double Acting Spring Hinges permit doors to open in either direction and automatically return to the closed position. Packaged complete with a Pair (2) Double Action Spring Door Hinges, Tension Adjusting Tool, Locking Pins plus wood mounting screws.

The included Tension Tool is use to adjust spring tension. The Locking Pins hold the Spring in tension after it is set. These adjustable tension spring hinges allow you to determine how much closing force you apply to the door (how hard/fast the door self closes).

Specifications of Global DH-TAN5005 Double Acting Spring Hinge
  • Material: Steel
  • Hinge Size: 5"
  • Non-Handed
  • Hinge Type: Mortise
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/8" - 1-1/2" Thick Doors
  • Maximum Swing: 90º each direction
  • Global DH-TAN5005 Dimension Diagram (PDF)
